text: This green cloud shoots out of your toilet every time you flush with the lid open.
And it's real: scientists filmed it with lasers.
In twenty twenty-two, University of Colorado engineers lit up a flushing toilet with lasers.
A cloud of tiny droplets shot up to five feet high in about eight seconds.
The smallest ones can linger in the air.
It helps. But a twenty twenty-four study found it did not clearly reduce viruses on bathroom surfaces.
So clean the bowl and the handle, keep your toothbrush covered and away from the toilet, and air out the room.
